rows.scene: A single giant stride of Vishnu spans three simple world bands above a kneeling devotee, with the other stride implied beyond the frame by symbolic scale rather than duplicated bodies.
rows.candidate_status: Producer reinspected at native resolution and enlarged Bhattathiri face, joined-hands and seated-body crop. Trivikrama’s one face and two attached arms are coherent; the giant foot and planted foot are visible and each shows five toes. Bhattathiri is a distinct seated figure with a coherent face and joined prayer hands. Skin-only 32×32 medians remain face R−B=123, chest R−B=142 and arm R−B=138. DISCLOSED DEVIATION: Bhattathiri’s two folded feet are naturally concealed beneath his cream dhoti; no foot or toe is visible, so the plan’s visible-feet clause is not met for Bhattathiri. Trivikrama’s feet remain visible. No other defect was observed in the inspected frame and crops. Unapproved; last independent exact-checksum review pending.

rows.scene: Place the ladle-offering worshipper at left with two seated worshippers beside the altar, and one calm blue Vishnu murti at right; keep all figures, hands, ladle, bowl and flame distinct.
rows.candidate_status: Producer reinspected the native frame and enlarged worshipper group, hands and folded-leg crop. Three distinct worshippers and one standing Guruvayurappan murti remain coherent, with no fused or duplicate people or malformed faces. The murti’s visible feet show five toes each; the three worshippers’ legs are folded and naturally covered by their dhotis. DISCLOSED DEVIATION: all three worshippers’ feet are naturally concealed beneath their dhoti folds; no worshipper foot or toe is visible, so the plan’s visible-feet clause is not met for those figures. The murti’s face and upper torso remain muted slate-gray: producer skin-only 32×32 cheek patch at origin (1214,180) median RGB (100,109,110), B−R=10; upper-torso patch at origin (1219,348) RGB (88,97,96), B−R=8; independent reviewer M measured face point (1240,210) sRGB(102,112,116), B−R=14, all below the contract minimum B−R=40. No other defect was observed in the inspected frame and crops. Unapproved; last independent exact-checksum review pending.

rows.candidate_status: Producer inspected at native resolution and focused face, hand and feet views. Two distinct poets flank Bhattathiri; one plays a veena. Skin-only face patch R-B=122, 117 and 118. Independent exact-checksum review pending; unapproved.

rows.scene: Set the three contemplative figures before one Vishnu form, with a small empty jewel seat as a restrained friendship hint; no extra people or repeated scenes.
rows.candidate_status: Producer reinspected the native frame and enlarged Vishnu face, folded hands and cross-legged robe crop. Vishnu is one coherent two-armed figure with an intact face; the lap hands overlap naturally with no extra or fused digit visible. Bhattathiri and both sages remain distinct, and their visible feet are inside the frame. DISCLOSED DEVIATION: Vishnu’s cross-legged seated pose and lower ochre robe folds naturally conceal both feet; no Vishnu foot or toe is visible, so the plan’s visible-feet clause is not met for the murti. No other defect was observed in the inspected frame and crops. Unapproved; last independent exact-checksum review pending.

rows.scene: Three separate people in simple daily postures occupy the foreground; Bhattathiri gestures with compassion toward a quiet Vishnu presence.
rows.candidate_status: Producer inspected the native image and enlarged carrier foot, hand and face views, the other faces, and visible feet. The carrier stands separately in front of and beside the seated pair; both legs and feet are fully visible with frame margin. The near foot shows five distinct toe forms; the side-view foot shows one large toe and four separated smaller toe forms. Both hands remain attached; the visible support hand shows a thumb plus four fingers. The seated man, garland maker, Bhattathiri and Guruvayurappan each have one head and two arms; visible feet are in-frame with five toe forms, and Guruvayurappan’s raised open hand shows a thumb plus four fingers. DISCLOSED DEVIATION: skin-only 32×32 medians are carrier (630,225) RGB (181,92,37), R−B=144; seated fruit maker (190,510) RGB (179,91,36), R−B=143; garland maker (445,480) RGB (180,93,37), R−B=143; Bhattathiri (870,360) RGB (177,92,38), R−B=139, against the approximately 120 target. Guruvayurappan cheek at (1355,160) RGB (62,73,91), B−R=29, against the target of at least 40. Anatomy and frame placement pass producer inspection; these palette deviations remain for independent exact-checksum review. Unapproved.

rows.scene: Use one monumental central cosmic figure with orderly, countable symbolic multiples and a distinct central face; no fragmented anatomy, separate duplicate bodies, or accidental extra limbs.
rows.candidate_status: Producer inspected at native resolution and enlarged true-edge head, central face/hand, and full feet-row crops. One central face and distinct symbolic profile tiers; the outermost left and right profiles are fully inside the frame with about 90px of margin each (about 5.4% width). One connected central body has two attached arms and two hands; the folded lap hands overlap naturally, with no extra limb or stray digit visible. The complete repeated feet row remains inside the frame; enlarged foot details show five toe marks per visible foot. Central-face 32x32 medians: at (790,232) RGB (102,114,119), B-R=17; at (852,232) RGB (106,117,122), B-R=16; slate/deep blue appearance remains close to v002 (B-R=19/15 at the same patches). Independent exact-checksum review pending; unapproved.
